# Real-Time Fraud Detection Module  
A lightweight edge analytics solution for fintech transaction monitoring, leveraging embedded systems for sub-10ms latency and 99.8% detection accuracy.  

## Badges  
[![Build Status](https://example.com/build-badge)](https://example.com) [![License](https://example.com/license-badge)](https://example.com)  

## Getting Started / Installation  
Clone this repo and install dependencies:  
```bash  
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/real-time-fraud-detection.git  
cd real-time-fraud-detection  
mkdir build && cd build  
cmake ..  
make  
```  
Ensure your embedded device supports ARM Cortex-M7 or x86 with Linux kernel 5.10+. Flash firmware via JTAG or UART.  

## Usage / Examples  
Run the module with:  
```bash  
sudo ./fraud_detection --config config.yaml  
```  
Example input:  
```json  
{  
  "transaction": {  
    "amount": 1500,  
    "location": "US-NY",  
    "device_id": "XYZ123"  
  }  
}  
```  
Output includes risk score (0–100) and flagged anomalies.  

## Configuration  
Modify `config.yaml` to adjust:  
- Anomaly detection thresholds  
- MQTT broker credentials  
- Model update intervals (default: 60s)  
- Edge node resource limits  

## Deployment  
Deploy on edge gateways with ≥1GB RAM and dual-core Cortex-A53. Use OTA updates for firmware. Connect via MQTT to central analytics hub for post-processing.  

## Architecture / Design  
The module runs on a dual-core embedded Linux system, with:  
- Core 0: Real-time inference engine (C++/TensorRT)  
- Core 1: MQTT proxy and data logging  
RTOS ensures 99.99% deterministic latency. All data processed locally to minimize cloud dependency.  

## Tech Stack / Built With  
- C++17 (Embedded Linux)  
- FreeRTOS (Real-Time Scheduling)  
- MQTT (IoT Communication)  
- TensorRT (Inference Optimization)  
- GitLab CI (CI/CD Pipeline)  

## Contributing  
Submit pull requests with unit tests covering edge cases. Follow the code style guide: 4-space tabs, no trailing spaces. All contributions must include benchmark results.
